headline: Session done — eccentric circuit + spin both landed light, exactly as scripted
summary: Both pieces are logged and match the prescription: Strength block was 20min at an average HR of 81bpm (max 113) — genuinely light, no sign of grinding through the step-downs — and the spin was 20min Z1-ish at 132bpm avg, RPE 2/feel 2. No pain flagged, no interval markers suggesting anyone pushed past the eccentric-habit intent. This was deliberately kept easy so Saturday's mountain long run carries this week's real eccentric/descent load — mission accomplished, quads should be fresh for that.
